propositions: The harness builds a vendored Dockerfile (not pulled from a registry) that pins the addono base image by digest and includes mandatory AMPS entrypoint flags to work around retired Marketplace v1 endpoints and Cargo deploy timeouts
Jira 8.17.1 is the pinned version because it is ≥8.14 (when Personal Access Tokens were introduced) and exercises the DC transport's PAT bearer auth mode against a real instance, not a fake

The instance is started on loopback-scoped port 127.0.0.1:2990 with tty and stdin_open enabled, and mounts a persistent Maven cache volume because the runtime downloads ~900 Jira artifacts from maven.atlassian.com on first start

The harness lives under tests/external/ and participates in the all-skip canary via _live_jira_ready sentinel, so a run where every test skipped fails the session rather than reporting vacuous success

The readiness probe has a 20-minute default timeout (overridable by env var) and runs at 5-second cadence because native amd64 startup is ~3-5 minutes but emulated arm64 reaches 10+ minutes, and CI job runs on ubuntu-latest (native x86_64) while local runs on Apple Silicon are constrained

A GitHub Actions job in external-integration.yml runs the harness on a native amd64 runner with docker compose build/up/down, and the pre-existing external job adds --ignore=tests/external/live_jira_dc to prevent canary masking when multiple jira_live tiers collect in one session
